provenance: Wait-time reference site candidates bundled as initial data for the distribution, v1 (record CV, 2026-11-21). The set is the candidate list registered in the production app: every entry was copied verbatim from one row of the production app's wait_time_sources table (saved production DB, opened read-only), and each entry's source names that production row's id, so every bundled value (name, URL, park, what can be read, fetch method, last-checked and created timestamps) is traceable to its source row. A copy starts with exactly these rows registered (migration 0049 at build time; the seed in server/src/wait_time_seed.ts on reset); no build-time survey is performed. Site names and URLs live only in this data file and its mechanical copies (the seed and migration 0049), never in the spec body. The fetch methods are the production DB's recorded values (all six rows: browser); where migration 0018's file text says script for two of the rows, the production DB's value was bundled, because the DB is the live registration. No value in this file comes from AI memory and no site was re-checked live for this bundling: lastCheckedAt / createdAt are the production rows' own timestamps, preserved as-is.

counts.note: Counts over the bundled candidate set (the full production wait_time_sources table at extraction).
